description: Everything needed to debug one error issue: what it is, its status and history, how often and for whom it happens in the window (by release, environment, browser, URL, tag), the latest occurrence's stack trace (source-mapped when available, each in-app frame linking to its file in the repository once the project's repository URL is set), breadcrumbs and request, and the product events that user sent in the 30 minutes before it.

issueId.description: The issue id (from list_issues) or its Vinktar URL, as a person would paste it.

last.description: Relative window ending now, e.g. "1h", "24h", "7d", "30d", "90d". Default "14d". Ignored when `from` is given.

name: get_issue
title: Get issue
